clarity_cognitive_load.evidence: sv1 ground truth, load gap significant at p=0.0026; T1 vs T5 63/63 exchanges harder to read, mean FK-grade gap +6.46
clarity_cognitive_load.judge_note: +0.013, p = 1.0000 on the same T1-vs-T5 contrast (Finding 20)

proactive_clarification.method: derived: clarification RATE on the ambiguity-labelled subset
proactive_clarification.evidence: 14/14 correct across 2 independently generated corpora; worst false-positive rate elsewhere 0.000

student_level_calibration.method: derived: explicit miscalibration only (student disclaims a term)
student_level_calibration.evidence: 11/17 on the covered labelled subset across two corpora. The negative half works (9/11); the positive half does not (2/6) and implicit calibration needs a learner model.

sequentiality.method: derived: library-cued forward references, no judge
sequentiality.evidence: 7/12 planted forward references caught across three corpora; 18/239 = 0.075 on unlabelled exchanges. On the T1/T4 minimal pair the only exchanges flagged in T4 and not T1 are plants.

consistency.method: in-context decomposed probe, not a whole-dialogue rating
consistency.evidence: 2/5 planted self-misattributions caught, with ZERO false positives on the clean arm and on T4's untouched exchanges (Selene, the project judge). The three misses are judgement failures, not detection failures: the probe saw the backward reference every time and returned supported=yes on two and cannot_tell on one. Precise and insensitive. Six approaches documented as failing, including three dialogue/NLI models all BELOW chance (AUC 0.328, 0.328, 0.383). Qwen3-8B also caught 2, but a DIFFERENT two.
consistency.judge_note: whole-dialogue rating scored a perfect 1.00 on 5 planted violations

criterion_applicability.evidence: good 0.296 vs pedagogically degraded 0.153, Fisher p=0.0095; the three non-pedagogical arms correctly flat (p=0.48, 0.49, 0.35). The RATING channel separates nothing (p=1.0000).
criterion_applicability.judge_note: K_s (mean rating over applicable criteria): p = 0.1954
